GRID / A4REV / 03

Controlled delivery

Fewer surprises.
Cleaner handoffs.

Every package moves through visible checkpoints. Your team knows what is in review, what changed, and what is ready to release.

Plan your package ↗

  1. We align drawing conventions, model inputs, connection responsibility, schedule, and submittal milestones before production begins.

  2. Detailers develop the model while tracking design gaps, trade interfaces, and constructability questions in a structured RFI log.

  3. Independent checks verify member geometry, connections, marks, dimensions, and drawing consistency before client review.

  4. Approved packages are issued with fabrication files and reports, then supported through revisions and field coordination.
